How it works

1. ShareThe owner exports the files they choose. NDA first, read-only.
2. CompareZonar OS matches the files against each other.
3. BriefHALU writes a short plain-language brief for each owner.
4. Decide and closeA named person approves. HALU follows up until closed.

It works from exported files, not live connections, and it is a check at a point in time, not round-the-clock monitoring. It does not replace a security audit.
